source_of_rubric_semantics: Harbor #297 issuecomment-6456421623 (M5 v0.4) six-dimension research rubric description
canonical_package_status: WAIT_MISSING_PACKAGE: m5_e2_professional_review_v0_1 (ZIP sha256 8f4a52a12854c0e7e63250f4bb43edef4cc47734d43b9ceac7edeb2d9d9fe425) was never transferred to this machine; this freeze follows the six dimensions AS DESCRIBED in #297 v0.4 and invents no numeric thresholds. If the canonical rubric JSON differs materially, affected verdicts must be re-validated.

dimensions.d1_visual_story_relevance: Do rendered visuals relate to the story/theme the script describes? Scored per scripted visual scene, not per image count. Single-image is not automatically a defect.
dimensions.d2_narrative_completeness: Does the text arc carry a complete hook-development-resolution story, and do visuals contribute anything to it?
dimensions.d3_subtitle_readability: Legibility (size/contrast/position), reading load (chars/sec, block size), typography correctness. Char speed is a flagged risk, never an automatic FAIL.
dimensions.d4_pacing: Cue duration variation, visual pacing variation, total length vs script plan and platform norms. Retention behavior UNKNOWN by construction here.
dimensions.d5_audio_content: Musical/narrative fit of the audio track. NOT SCORED in this session (cannot listen): stays UNKNOWN. Technical signal facts and source-identity metadata are recorded as facts, not quality scores.
dimensions.d6_source_rights_expression_risk: Origin and licensing exposure of image/audio assets, typography/expression risks. Rights facts are flagged; actual licensing status may stay UNKNOWN.

verdict_vocabulary: PASS / FAIL_CANDIDATE / PARTIAL / UNKNOWN per dimension; overall E2 NOT_PASS unless every dimension has grounded PASS and coverage claims hold
anti_gaming_rules: Evaluator may not modify this rubric and then grade against the modified version
Single-image style is scored via d1 relevance, not image count (anti complexity-bias rule)
A hypothetical multi-image video with wrong-theme images must not score above a single coherent image (recorded as argument, not measured)
E1 technical PASS does not transfer to any E2 dimension
Audio content cannot be inferred from metadata or levels
scope: Research rubric for M5 v0.4 validation only; NOT the novel project's formal E2 publishing gate; grants no publishing authorization.
